newsitem.title: USA: Selfcare begins offering of 1.8 million shrs.
newsitem.headline: Selfcare begins offering of 1.8 million shrs.

text.p: Selfcare Inc Friday said it has begun a public offering of 1.8 million shares of its common stock at $10 per share, all of which are being sold by the company.
The offering is being made through Lehman Brothers, Dillon, Read & Co Inc and A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc.
The company said it granted the underwriters a 30 day option to purchase up to an additional 270,000 shares of its common stock to cover over-allotments.

Net proceeds to the Company of about $16.3 million will be used to fund a portion of the consideration payable in the Company's acquisition of Orgenics Ltd, to repay certain indebtedness and for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
Shares of Selfcare fell 1-1/2 to 10 in late morning trade on Friday.
